gloss: terminus; final stop; end of the line

definitions.explanation: The last stop on a train, bus, or other transportation route. Most commonly encountered in the compound 終着駅 (terminal station).
Used figuratively to refer to the ultimate destination or conclusion of a journey, career, or life path.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}の{終着|しゅうちゃく}は{東京|とうきょう}です。
examples.english: The final stop of this train is Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}で{全員|ぜんいん}{降|お}りてください。
examples.english: Please all disembark at the terminal station.

examples.japanese: {終着|しゅうちゃく}まで{乗|の}っていたら、{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{運転|うんてん}で{戻|もど}される。
examples.english: If you ride to the last stop, you'll be taken back on the return service.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{終着|しゅうちゃく}はだれにもわからない。
examples.english: Nobody knows the final destination of their life.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{旅|たび}の{終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}にようやく{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I finally arrived at the end point of my long journey.

examples.japanese: この{研究|けんきゅう}の{終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}は{新薬|しんやく}の{開発|かいはつ}だった。
examples.english: The end point of this research was the development of a new drug.

notes:
Composed of {終|しゅう} (end) + {着|ちゃく} (arrival). Most frequently used in transportation contexts, particularly in the compound {終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}. Also used figuratively for the end point of any extended process or journey.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}: terminal station
- {終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}: end point, final destination
- {終着|しゅうちゃく}まで: all the way to the last stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終点|しゅうてん}: end point, last stop — more common in everyday speech for bus/train stops
- {目的地|もくてきち}: destination — where one intends to go, not necessarily the end of a route
- {到着|とうちゃく}: arrival — the act of arriving, not specific to a final stop
